notes.en: Qualified in a real Linux/riscv64 guest using the declared NumPy and pandas layer: the complete verifier, file analysis and the pandas/stdlib cross-check passed. A separate import-denial run proved the required paths without unrelated union-installed modules. The exact Debian dependency declaration is pinned; tools and capabilities are unchanged. These are component CLI results, not per-skill native UI or physical-device acceptance.
